correctness.rationale: The rank-one linear map is trace(BX)A with a unique output line. Direct coefficient comparison of the Rota–Baxter identity yields A²=lambda A, BA=mu B, AB=(lambda-mu)B and mu(mu-lambda)=0 in any characteristic. For lambda=0, B is any nonzero map V/im A to ker A; rank-r square-zero A count is [n r]_q[n-r r]_q |GL_r|, divided by q-1 for output lines. For lambda!=0 the unique idempotent E on the output line has complementary eigenspaces, and B lies in one of the two disjoint nonzero off-diagonal blocks. Hence S_nq+I_nq counts each operator once, and R²=0 follows from tr(BA)=0. The q-degree of the rank-one square-zero term is n²-2, strictly above all other ranks for n>=3. Independent integer evaluation reproduces n=2,q=2:3+12 and n=3,q=2:315+336. Finite samples cannot establish the symbolic generality.
